python3 - << 'EOF'
# Verify with explicit formula
yields = [3.25, 3.22, 3.19, 3.06, 3.04, 2.96,
          2.90, 2.85, 2.73, 2.70, 2.72, 2.70,
          2.62, 2.60, 2.64, 2.65, 2.68, 2.68,
          2.77, 2.92, 2.92, 2.92, 2.91, 2.91,
          2.96, 3.02, 3.00, 2.96, 2.96, 2.97,
          2.94, 2.93, 2.98, 3.10, 3.03, 2.98]

t = list(range(36))  # 0 to 35

# Verify length
assert len(yields) == 36, f"Expected 36, got {len(yields)}"

n = len(yields)
tbar = sum(t) / n
ybar = sum(yields) / n

# OLS slope and intercept
numerator = sum((t[i] - tbar) * (yields[i] - ybar) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((t[i] - tbar)**2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * tbar

print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"tbar = {tbar}")
print(f"ybar = {ybar}")
print(f"Sum of squares = {denominator}")
print(f"Slope = {slope}")
print(f"Intercept = {intercept}")

# Forecast for July 1956 (t = 36)
forecast = intercept + slope * 36
print(f"\nForecast for t=36 (July 1956): {forecast}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimals: {round(forecast, 3)}")

# Verify using numpy if available
try:
    import numpy as np
    t_arr = np.array(t)
    y_arr = np.array(yields)
    coeffs = np.polyfit(t_arr, y_arr, 1)
    print(f"\nNumPy verification: slope={coeffs[0]}, intercept={coeffs[1]}")
    print(f"NumPy forecast: {np.polyval(coeffs, 36)}")
except ImportError:
    print("\nNumPy not available for verification")

# Also check step-by-step manually
print("\nVerification of forecast:")
print(f"intercept + slope * 36 = {intercept} + {slope} * 36 = {intercept + slope * 36}")
EOF
